description: This file contains shell script tests for the 'git clone' command, specifically testing the '-c' configuration options and related behaviors such as setting configuration keys, handling shallow clones, remote fetch specifications, and dotfile visibility.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided shell commands and verifies their success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command fails.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks if the output of the previous command matches a given pattern.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or inputs for equality.

methods.name: test_path_is_hidden
methods.description: Checks whether a given path is hidden.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the repository with specified attributes.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets up cleanup commands to be run after the test.
